title: Junior AI Automation Developer
description: Junior AI Automation Developer (m/w/d) Location: Munich (Hybrid) Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent. About our Client: On behalf of a fast-growing, innovative AI & process automation consultancy, we are looking to reinforce the development team. Our client builds and deploys real-world AI and automation solutions for top-tier global brands across social media, automotive, and insurance sectors. The Position: We are looking for motivated talents with a computer science background who want to automate complex business processes using AI agents, APIs, and modern workflow platforms. The Role & Responsibilities: Workflow Development: Designing and building automated workflows primarily using n8n and complementary tools (Make, Zapier). System Integration: Seamlessly connecting disparate software systems via REST APIs, webhooks, and relational databases (SQL, Postgres, Airtable). Scripting & Code: Writing custom scripts in JavaScript or TypeScript for tailored business logic and edge cases. AI Agents & LLMs: Integrating state-of-the-art language models (OpenAI, Anthropic) and autonomous AI agents into active client processes. Deployment & Mentoring: Managing cloud runtime environments and working directly on client projects from day one with hands-on mentoring from senior devs. Profile: Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering, or a completed vocational IT training (e.g., Application Development). Solid foundational understanding of programming (scripting, OOP, JS/TS, Python) and general IT architecture (APIs, databases). Initial practical experience or strong passion for workflow automation, prompting, and AI solutions. Fluent German skills (C1 level mandatory) for team collaboration and client communication, along with good English skills. High self-motivation, problem-solving mindset, and willingness to collaborate on-site in the Munich office. This position offers a salary range of approx. EUR 42,000–60,000 gross per year (including a new M-series MacBook Pro, Claude Code subscription, and full dev setup). Further details will be shared in an in-depth conversation. We look forward to receiving your application and discussing the position and company in detail with you.
industries: IT Services and IT Consulting, Software Development, and Business Consulting and Services
